tool_plan.objective: Generate representative Chrome cache content and preserve it for ChromeCacheView parsing, metadata review, and export testing.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Starts Chromium with a profile where cache artifacts can be created.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Loads distinct web resources that populate Chrome cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observes available page controls before exercising meaningful visible content.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Performs realistic search input that can generate parameterized cached results.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Follows visible links or commits interactions to request additional cached resources.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveals lazy-loaded or lower-page resources that can add cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserves a visible representation of content associated with generated cache activity.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Closes the browser to flush pending cache data to the profile.

completion.detail: Complete after Chromium has been closed and chromium.cache.cache_data is present in the browser profile.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chromium using the designated profile. Use browser.goto with relevant run-provided runtime resources, favoring pages with visible, cacheable content and interactive resources. On each page, use browser.get_clickables to inspect currently visible controls, then use browser.smart_type where an available search or text input supports a realistic query and browser.smart_click to submit it or follow visible content links. Use browser.scroll to reveal lower-page or lazy-loaded content, then re-observe with browser.get_clickables and perform a bounded additional visible interaction where appropriate. Navigate among a few distinct runtime-provided resources to generate varied cached documents, images, scripts, search-result resources, and linked content. Capture browser.screenshot while meaningful loaded content is visible. Close the browser last so pending cache data is flushed, producing chromium.cache.cache_data.
